name: carddown
description: Convert Markdown files into paginated image cards from a TypeScript CLI.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && node scripts/test-config.js && node scripts/test-theme.js && node scripts/test-security.js && node scripts/test-parser.js && node scripts/test-validation.js && node dist/index.js --help && node dist/index.js --list-themes --json
scripts.test:render: npm run build && node dist/index.js -i examples/test-math.md --json --output output/render-test-math --name render-test-math --scale 1 --no-cover && node dist/index.js -i examples/demo-numerical-analysis.md --theme claude-like-dark --output output/render-demo-dark --name render-demo-dark --scale 1

author: WiseZenn
